# Switcher WebAPI

> Switcher WebAPI Documentation

The complete documentation is also available as a single file: [llms-full.txt](https://switcher-webapi.figenblat.com/llms-full.txt).

## Getting started

- [Home](<https://switcher-webapi.figenblat.com/index.md>): Overview, quick start, and architecture diagram

## API Endpoints

- [All Endpoints](<https://switcher-webapi.figenblat.com/endpoints_all/index.md>): All REST endpoints in a single reference
- [State Endpoints](<https://switcher-webapi.figenblat.com/endpoints_state/index.md>): Device state and telemetry endpoints
- [Action Endpoints](<https://switcher-webapi.figenblat.com/endpoints_action/index.md>): Device control endpoints (on/off, set power, timer)
- [Config Endpoints](<https://switcher-webapi.figenblat.com/endpoints_config/index.md>): Device configuration endpoints (name, auto-off)
- [Schedule Endpoint](<https://switcher-webapi.figenblat.com/endpoints_schedule/index.md>): Schedule management endpoints

## Device Types

- [Device Types](<https://switcher-webapi.figenblat.com/device_types/index.md>): Table of supported Switcher device types
